Known for their high-energy performances, they keep crowds on their feet with a full-scale production featuring lasers, fog, and dynamic lighting. Regularly appearing at venues and events across Northern California, Def Lepp delivers a hit-packed set of ‘80s arena rock favorites—capturing the spirit and excitement of a true Def Leppard concert experience. You can learn more about them by clicking here to visit their website. Only guests 18 and older may attend our “On Stage” concerts.

events.title: Hump Day Live’s Jam Nite with Melissa & Andrew
events.description: Join us at High-Hand Brewery as we launch our new Hump Day Jam Nite! Every Wednesday, we’re opening the stage to musicians of all kinds—bring your axe, your voice, your full band, or just the urge to play. When you arrive, find Melissa to sign up and lock in your spot. High-Hand’s pro backline will be ready for you. Solo players will be paired up into spontaneous jam groups, and together you’ll decide what to play—keeping it loose, creative, and fun. It’s all about rocking out, connecting with fellow musicians, and celebrating the amazing music community we’re surrounded by. Each week will also feature a guest band to keep the night energized and inspiring. Come jam, hang out, and make your Wednesday groove. Only guests 18 and older may attend our “On Stage” concerts.

Cheap Trick delivers the ultimate tribute — recreating the sound, style, and high-energy stage presence that made Cheap Trick iconic. Formed in 2021, the band brings fan-favorite hits to life with spot-on musicianship and a visually authentic show—complete with wild multi-neck guitars and all the flair you’d expect. If you’re looking to relive the magic of Cheap Trick live, Cheap Trip brings the party straight to the stage. Only guests 18 and older may attend our “On Stage” concerts.
